info.title: Crucible
info.description: The REST API of Crucible, observability and analytics for AI agents and MCP servers. Errors are `application/problem+json` documents with a stable `code`.

post.description:
One measure, at most two dimensions, a comparison with a threshold, and the timing of the evaluation. The
first evaluation is the next tick of the rule's schedule.

What the rule in the body would see if it were evaluated now: each series of the window that ends at the
last whole minute at least 30 s ago, with whether it breaches the threshold. Nothing is stored and nobody is
notified. The `name` is not used.

404.description: `not_found`.

delete.description: Deletes the rule with its state and its history.

patch.description: Changes the members in the body. A change to what the rule measures or when starts its series afresh.

404.description: `not_found`.

Answers the secret key once; it cannot be shown again. New keys have `ingest`, `read` and `write` unless

delete.description: The key stops working on this server at once and on every node within 5 s.

get.description:
The channels of the project, for whoever edits alert rules. The URL of a webhook and the recipients of an
email channel are left out for callers who may not manage channels.

404.description: `not_found`, or `feature_disabled` without a control plane.

post.description:
A Slack incoming webhook, an email channel or a signed webhook. A webhook channel gets a signing secret,
which this answer carries once. The target is checked against the egress policy.

422.description: `validation_failed`, or `ssrf_blocked` with the reason and the setting that allows the target.

404.description: `not_found`.

delete.description: Deletes the channel and its secret. Rules that name it stop notifying it.

patch.description:
Renames it, turns it on or off, replaces its target, or replaces the signing secret of a webhook channel.
Turning a channel on clears its failure count and the reason it was turned off.

post.description:
One synchronous attempt, at most 6 a minute per channel. The answer says whether the receiver accepted the
test, the class of its status and how long it took; it never carries what the receiver answered. A test
works on a channel that is turned off, so a fix can be checked before the channel is turned on again.

200.description: The outcome, also when the receiver refused.

404.description: `not_found`.

post.description:
Records the corrected output of a trace, a span or a session; `retracted: true` removes the correction.
The body is at most 1 MiB.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` and `-`; a repeat with the same body answers as the first request did.

get.description:
The project's dashboards, oldest first, then the built-in starter dashboards, which are read-only and carry
a `builtin_key`. Without a control plane, the built-in dashboards only.

404.description: `not_found`.

post.description:
A dashboard with its name and, optionally, its widgets. Each widget is checked against the rules of its kind
and the metrics schema, and no two may overlap.

404.description: `not_found`, or `feature_disabled` without a control plane.

get.description:
A dashboard with its widgets in reading order. `{dashboard_id}` is a dashboard's id or a built-in
dashboard's `builtin_key`.

parameters.name: dashboard_id
parameters.description: The dashboard id, or a built-in dashboard's key.

404.description: `not_found`.

delete.description: Deletes the dashboard with its widgets.

404.description: `not_found`.

patch.description:
Changes the name, the description, or the whole set of widgets in one change: a widget with an `id` is
rewritten, one without is added, and one the list leaves out is deleted. The result is checked whole, so
widgets can trade places.

200.description: The dashboard; `ETag` is its new version.

404.description: `not_found`.

post.description:
Copies a dashboard, or a built-in dashboard named by its key, into a new dashboard of the project, with new
widget ids. The copy can be changed.

parameters.name: dashboard_id
parameters.description: The dashboard id, or a built-in dashboard's key.

404.description: `not_found`, or `feature_disabled` without a control plane.

post.description:
Adds one widget where it does not overlap another. It takes no `If-Match`: when another change lands first,
the widget is checked again against it. The answer's `ETag` is the dashboard's new version.

201.description: The widget; `ETag` is the dashboard's new version.

404.description: `not_found`.

409.description: `conflict`: a built-in dashboard is read-only, or the dashboard kept changing.

delete.description: Removes one widget. The answer's `ETag` is the dashboard's new version.

204.description: Removed; `ETag` is the dashboard's new version.

404.description: `not_found`.

patch.description:
Changes the members in the body. A `markdown` display drops the query. The result is checked against the
dashboard's other widgets. The answer's `ETag` is the dashboard's new version.

200.description: The widget; `ETag` is the dashboard's new version.

404.description: `not_found`.

get.description:
Where the project's data begins and ends inside its retention, with the retention horizon, the widest
window a request may ask for and the server's clock.

404.description: `not_found`: the caller cannot see the project.

post.description:
Deletes a list of traces, everything of one user, or everything of one session. The delete is point in
time: data received after the request is kept. The answer comes once the request is durable; from then on
the API and the MCP server no longer return the data, and the request's `state` says how far the removal
from the telemetry store has come. Send an `Idempotency-Key` to make a retry safe. Deleting traces needs
the `delete_traces` permission (project member, or a key with the `delete` scope); deleting by user or
session needs `delete_by_user` (project admin, or a key with the `delete` scope).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` and `-`. A repeat with the same body returns the same request.

403.description: `forbidden`: the role or the key's scopes are too low.

404.description: `not_found`: the caller cannot see the project.

503.description: `control_plane_unavailable`, or `ingest_unavailable` when the write-ahead log cannot take the request yet.

get.description: One request with its state and the status of each place it reaches.

404.description: `not_found`.

get.description: The project's newest exports, newest first, at most 50, each with where it is in its life.

404.description: `not_found`: the caller cannot see the project; or `feature_disabled`: no control plane.

post.description:
Starts an export of the project's spans in a window, optionally narrowed to traces, a user or a session,
in the `crucible-jsonl` or `otlp-json` format. It answers at once; read the export to follow it, and download
the file once it is ready. Spans received after this request are not included. A project may create 5
exports per hour; an `Idempotency-Key` makes a retry answer with the export the first request created.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` and `-`; a repeat with the same body answers with the export the first request created.

403.description: `forbidden`: creating exports needs the `export` permission (project member, or a key with the `read` scope).

404.description: `not_found`: the caller cannot see the project; or `feature_disabled`: no control plane.

429.description: `rate_limited`: 5 exports per hour per project; `retry_after_s` says when.

get.description:
One export of the project: where it is in its life, how far it has come, and, once it is ready, its checksum,
expiry and download path.

404.description: `not_found`: no export of the project has this id; or `feature_disabled`: no control plane.

get.description: The file of a ready export, streamed from the node that wrote it, with its SHA-256 as the `ETag`.

200.description: The file: JSON lines, gzip-compressed when the export asked for it.

404.description: `not_found`: no export of the project has this id, or its file is not on this node (a deployment of several nodes keeps each file on the node that wrote it); or `feature_disabled`: no control plane.

409.description: `conflict`: the export is not ready yet, or failed.

410.description: `export_expired`: the file expired, or a deletion request the export predates expired it.

get.description:
Where media appear in one trace, or in one span of it: one entry per use, by payload field, each with its
media's metadata. Read `GET media/{media_id}` for a download.

parameters.name: span_id
parameters.description: The span, 16 hexadecimal characters; without it, every use in the trace.

404.description: `not_found`: the caller cannot see the project.

post.description:
Declares bytes a span uses and answers the media id with a presigned `PUT`, valid for an hour, whose
content type, length and SHA-256 are signed headers: send them exactly as listed. When the project already
holds these bytes, the answer has no upload, and the use is recorded at once. Then upload the bytes to the
URL and confirm with `PATCH media/{media_id}`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` and `-`; a repeat with the same body answers as the first request did.

201.description: The media id, and the upload when the bytes are not stored yet.

403.description: `forbidden`: uploading needs an API key with the `ingest` scope.

404.description: `not_found`: the key cannot see the project.

get.description:
The media's metadata and, once it is uploaded, a presigned download on the object store that lives 5
minutes. Images, audio and video of common types are served inline; every other type downloads as a file.

404.description: `not_found`: no media of the project has this id, or it was deleted.

patch.description:

store reports it) and marks the media uploaded. Confirming uploaded media answers it again.

200.description: The media, uploaded, with a presigned download.

403.description: `forbidden`: confirming needs an API key with the `ingest` scope.

404.description: `not_found`: no media of the project has this id, or its upload expired after 24 hours.

422.description: `media_hash_mismatch`: the upload differs from what was declared; upload again.

at most 500 buckets per series, 20 keys and 10,000 points. Keys beyond `top_n` form an `other` series for

403.description: `forbidden`: retention needs the project admin role.

404.description: `not_found`: the caller cannot see the project.

422.description: `validation_failed`: a value is out of range, or above `retention_days`.

scores.description: The scores, by name. In trace lists they carry no comment or metadata.

tags.description: The effective tags: the tags the trace was sent with, plus the added ones, minus the removed ones.

TraceListItem.description:
One trace of the list: its head (the root span, or the earliest span while the root has not arrived) and
the trace's merged aggregates.

duration_us.description: From the trace's first span start to its last span end, in microseconds.

environment.description: The head span's environment; empty until the store serves the head.

facts.description: The trace's facts. Scores carry no comment or metadata here, and there is no correction.

head_kind.description: Whether the head is the root span.

release.description: The head span's release; empty until the store serves the head.

saturated.description: Whether a count above saturated at 2^53 - 1.

session_id.description: The trace's session, picked like the trace name.

start_time.description: The head span's start, the list's sort key.

tags.description:
The effective trace tags: the head's tags, which are empty until the store serves the head, plus the
tags added by edits, minus the removed ones.

total_cost_usd.description: The trace's total cost in USD.

trace_name.description: The trace name: the root span's, else the latest non-empty one; empty when no span set one.

user_id.description: The trace's user, picked like the trace name.

TraceListPage.description:
One page of the trace list, newest first; or, for a `since` request, the traces that arrived after the
head cursor.

has_more.description: Whether another page exists, or, for live tail, whether more traces arrived than `data` holds.

head_cursor.description: The cursor to pass as `since` for live tail; set on first pages and live-tail responses, else null.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the page is.

new_count.description: For live tail only: how many traces arrived, saturating at 100.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page and on live-tail responses.

user_id.description: The member who becomes the owner; the current owner becomes an admin.

UserDetail.description:
One user. A user without spans in the window is `not_found`, unless the answer may be incomplete: then
`user` is null and `meta` says why.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the answer is.

oneOf.description: The user, or null when the answer may be incomplete.

UserItem.description: One user: the spans that name the user in the window's days, aggregated.

last_seen.description: The latest span end; the list's sort key.

saturated.description: Whether a count above saturated at 2^53 - 1.

session_count.description: The distinct sessions that the user's traces in the window name.

user_id.description: The user id, as the spans name it.

UserPage.description: One page of the user list, last seen first.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the page is.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

UserSessionItem.description: One session of a user, from the user's traces in the window.

first_trace_at.description: The start of the session's earliest trace of the user in the window.

last_trace_at.description: The start of the latest one; the list's sort key.

saturated.description: Whether a count above saturated at 2^53 - 1.

trace_count.description: The user's traces in the session.

UserSessionPage.description: One page of the sessions of a user, latest trace first.

meta.description: How complete and how fresh the page is.

next_cursor.description: The cursor of the next page; null on the last page.

UserStatus.description: Whether a user may sign in.

`POST .../widgets` does not take it.

oneOf.description: The query; required unless the widget is `markdown`, which takes none.

A widget's rectangle on the dashboard's grid of 12 columns, in cells. Rows are as tall as columns are wide.
Widgets of one dashboard never overlap.

h.description: The height in rows, at most 12.

w.description: The width in columns, at most 12.

WidgetPatch.description: The body of `PATCH .../widgets/{widget_id}`: the members to change. A `markdown` display drops the query.

oneOf.description: How it is drawn.
Where it sits.
The query.

WidgetQuery.description:
A widget's metrics query: `MetricsQuery` v1 without its window, which the dashboard's time range supplies. Its
members are those of the body of `POST metrics/query` other than `from` and `to`.

oneOf.description: Source `mcp_ops` only: which capture source each server is read from (contract 9.5); `auto` by default.

dimensions.description: Up to two dimension ids of the source, to split the series by.

oneOf.description: What an empty bucket holds; `zero` by default.
A filter over the source's filter fields.

include_caller_faults.description: Source `mcp_ops` only: whether calls the caller caused count; false by default (contract 9.2).

oneOf.description: Source `mcp_ops` only, and required there: the side to read, `client` or `server`.

source.description: The source, as the metrics schema lists it.

timezone.description: The time zone of the buckets. Only `UTC` is supported yet.

top_n.description: With dimensions: how many keys to return, 1 to 20, default 20.

project_key.description: A project's secret key (`csk_...`) as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
